description: Analyze a Reddit user's posting history, karma, and activity patterns. Returns posts, comments, and statistics.

comments_limit.description: Default 10, range (0-100). Override ONLY IF user asks.

posts_limit.description: Default 10, range (0-100). Change ONLY IF user specifies.

time_range.description: Time range for posts/comments (default: month). Note: When set to values other than "all", posts are sorted by top scores within that period. When set to "all", posts are sorted by newest

top_subreddits_limit.description: Default 10, range (1-50). Change ONLY IF user requests.

name: user_analysis
